item.title: Time Finance agrees £55m cash takeover by Ultimate Finance owner
item.summary: Time Finance has agreed to a £55.1m cash takeover by Bentley Park, the parent of specialist lender Ultimate Finance, in a deal that would create one of the UK’s larger independent lenders to small businesses.
